_meta.purpose: EMERGENCY and HIGH referral routing for Maharashtra. Same schema and ranking as up_district_hospitals.json, loaded alongside it: referralService reads every *_district_hospitals.json in this directory.
_meta.coordinates: District headquarters, where the government district hospital sits, accurate to the town. The two Mumbai districts use a named public general hospital, positioned at its locality.
_meta.district_names: Current official names. Ahilyanagar was Ahmednagar, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar was Aurangabad, Dharashiv was Osmanabad. Former names are kept in "formerly", and hospitalForDistrict matches either.
_meta.sourcing_rule: Null where unsourced; never guess. Only ownership and facility type are filled, and only where they follow from the record itself. Populate the rest against a real source with ingestFacilities.js --dataset mh_district_hospitals.json.
_meta.coverage: 36 government district-level hospitals, one per district. Private and PM-JAY empanelled facilities are NOT yet seeded; the ranking engine treats every null field as unverified, never as absent.
_meta.capacity: NOT INCLUDED BY DESIGN. There is no public real-time bed-availability feed. Any number here would be invented, and an invented bed count on a referral screen is dangerous. The UI instructs the health worker to confirm capacity before transporting.
_meta.phone_numbers: Null where a verified public number was not available; the UI falls back to the national 108 ambulance line rather than showing a wrong number.
